rubrics.justification: Reasonably identifies a blastocyst and notes grading nuance, but overstates confidence in ICM/TE quality from this single image and mentions possible hatching/zona features not clearly visible.
Thoroughly integrates maternal age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, sperm parameters, endometrium, and cycle history with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logic is structured, but the implantation estimate is optimistic for an untested age-40 embryo and somewhat inconsistent with the emphasis on high aneuploidy risk.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading principles and IVF practice, including SET preference and hydrosalpinx caution, though outcome estimates are somewhat higher than typical evidence-based expectations at age 40.
Provides clear practical recommendations for transfer, pre-transfer checks, luteal support, and future planning, though some suggestions remain broad rather than protocol-specific.
